name: Zirconium (beta)
notes: Ideal beta-Zr structure; the cubic lattice is calculated from the constrained conventional-cell V0.

eos_records.label: McHardy et al. (2026), beta Vinet
eos_records.notes: The beta-phase fit used the selected constrained value V0 = 22.6 A^3/atom. The paper cautions that this far-extrapolated reference volume has no direct physical significance; it is doubled here for the conventional bcc cell.
